title: Stop Sale Required Event v1
description: Published when stop-sale is required for a scope. This is a high-risk suppression signal and must not be ignored by consumer channels.
$comment: Sources: PACK-01 Recall Stop-Sale Gate; MASTER-07 stop-sale governance; OD-RCL-03 (2026-07-17). Emit for every durable SaleLockActivated with the same sale_lock_id, scope_type, scope_id and correlation/causation chain; recall-case creation alone does not emit this event.

eventType.description: Stable event type including source, domain, name, and v1 suffix.

source.description: System that owns and emits this event.

causationId.description: Optional parent command, event, or workflow identifier.

idempotencyKey.description: Required when emitted from retryable or high-risk command; optional for derived read-model notifications.
